findings.reason: the plan should search the state it already holds and restate §2's remainder as verifying the read on the restarted server rather than re-declaring what is already declared and labelled.
findings.text: the section's done-when asks that four directions be declared in reckon's project state and that plans carry labels resolving to them, but `docs/state/reckon/project.json` already declares all four (`state-that-tells-the-truth`, `unattended-execution`, `legible-to-human-and-agent`, `portable-across-harnesses`); that file is the canonical `project` resource the distributed-state marker at `docs/.reckon/project-state-migration.json` names; and 57 files under `docs/plans/` already carry `plan-north-star` labels matching those ids, so the plan proposes work already present in the state it holds

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module; the only code §3 adds sits inside the existing `_crew_rows` join and still hides pointer, roster and plan-detail assembly behind that one entry point.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the run phase §3 derives is owned by `reckon/crew/recovery.py` (`classify_pointer`/`_observed_phase`), the plan-head read by `reckon/_plan_html.py`, and memoisation by the shared `reckon/file_memo.memoized`; the landed change extends those owners rather than forking them.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1470, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; no section adds a definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family — §2 populates an already-landed collection and §3/§4 change no interface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §2 proposes to declare four directions and label plans, but the canonical project resource already declares all four and 57 plans already carry matching labels.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §4 adds a test, not a layer; it executes the shipped sprint view through the existing `tests/spa_module_eval` harness rather than wrapping the sprint route.
